# Sun Systems & Service Inc

> Tanning bed parts, red light bed parts and tanning salon equipment supplies, sourced by request for every make and model, including discontinued beds, and shipped anywhere in the US. Also on-site tanning and red light bed repair, maintenance and installation in Metro Detroit and Michigan. In business since 1990. Phone (248) 545-5577, open 7 days, 9am to 6pm.

Founder and technician: Stan Pope, former tanning salon owner, technician since 1990, co-author of five published papers on ultraviolet light.

## What we supply

- Tanning bed lamps and bulbs, relamp sets matched to the bed's lamp code
- Tanning bed acrylics (bench and canopy)
- Ballasts (magnetic and electronic) and starters
- Timers, remote timer systems and control boards
- Fans, cooling parts and thermal cutoffs
- Gas springs and shocks for canopies
- Electrical parts: contactors, relays, lamp holders, wiring, cords
- Red light bed parts: LED panels and arrays, LED drivers and power supplies, controls, fans, acrylics
- Hybrid (UV plus red light) tanning bed parts
- Used tanning beds, stand-up booths and red light beds, inspected before sale

## Brands

Ergoline, ETS, KBL, Wolff, ProSun, Sunquest, SunFire, Sunmaster, ESB, SunStar, Montego Bay, Sun Dash, Soltron, and every other make of tanning bed, stand-up booth, hybrid bed and red light bed.

## Services

- On-site tanning bed and red light bed repair across Metro Detroit and Michigan; special jobs in Ohio, Indiana and Northern Michigan
- Paid video repair sessions anywhere in the US
- Home and salon tanning bed and red light bed installation
- New tanning salon setup: equipment, layout, wiring, ventilation, startup
- Pre-purchase video inspection of used tanning beds
- Relamp Plan for salons
